headline: Five years after deadly migrant shipwreck in the English Channel, rescuers blame each other: 'It's too easy to say we didn't know'
description: During a confrontation before an investigating judge in June, the duty officer and the operator at the maritime rescue center presented irreconcilable accounts of the events of November 24, 2021. That night, 31 people drowned between French and British waters.

headline: 'It is just as wrong to make social media the sole cause of adolescent distress as it is to deny its power to amplify it'
description: Our responsibility as adults is neither to abandon teenagers in digital spaces nor to keep them away from them, as young people’s mental health deserves better than a clash between technophiles and technophobes, writes child psychiatrist Pierre Fourneret in an op-ed for Le Monde.

headline: How hard-left politician Rima Hassan is testing the boundaries between free speech and provocation
description: Hassan will stand trial for 'terrorism glorification' in October, over a tweet citing one of the perpetrators of the 1972 Tel Aviv airport attack.
